# <span id="aanchor115"></span> Quality Assignment Editor

## Liquid Meter Assignment - Options Details

These selections in the Options groupbox will determine which sample of the source is applied to meter data. (See also: [Configuring Assignments](Configuring%20Assignments.md))



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 610;height: 128;" />

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Apply Sample At">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Apply Sample At</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Apply Sample At">

Users can elect to apply samples at the end of a batch or at the effective date/time.

### End of Batch

When applied at the end of a batch, a sample with a sample date that matches the end effective date of the batch is applied to the entire batch.

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="End of Batch Ex">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

A sample with a sample date of 01/13/2023 09:00 is applied to the entirety of a batch dated 01/01/2023 09:00 – 01/13/2023 09:00.

</div>

##### Sample Tolerance

End-of-batch assignments are subject to sample tolerance limits that are configured on the [Liquids tab of the Meter Editor](../../Meters/Meter%20Editor/Liquids%20Tab.md). When a sample tolerance is set, a sample with a date that is outside of the tolerance will not be applied.

##### Use First Sample

The Use First Sample option is available for end-of-batch assignments with a sample tolerance set. When this option is enabled, if there are multiple samples that fall within the sample tolerance of the end of the batch, the earliest sample will be used. By default, FLOWCAL will use the latest chronological sample that meets all specified criteria.

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Sample Apply Ex">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Sample Apply Ex">

A meter has a sample tolerance of one hour before and after the end of the batch.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 256;height: 92;" />

The meter has one batch:

| Effective Date     | Effective Date End  |
|--------------------|---------------------|
| 11/30/2023 9:00:00 | 11/30/2023 12:00:00 |

The liquid quality source has four samples:

| Sample Date         |
|---------------------|
| 11/29/2023 00:00:00 |
| 11/30/2023 11:45:00 |
| 11/30/2023 12:00:00 |
| 11/30/2023 12:00:01 |

Samples are applied as follows, based on configuration options:

- End of batch assignment, with no other option enabled:
  | Batch                       | Sample Applied      |
  |-----------------------------|---------------------|
  | 11/30/2023 9:00:00-12:00:00 | 11/30/2023 12:00:01 |
- End of batch assignment, with **Use First Sample** option enabled:
  | Batch                       | Sample Applied      |
  |-----------------------------|---------------------|
  | 11/30/2023 9:00:00-12:00:00 | 11/30/2023 11:45:00 |
- End of batch assignment, with **Use Prior** option enabled:
  | Batch                       | Sample Applied      |
  |-----------------------------|---------------------|
  | 11/30/2023 9:00:00-12:00:00 | 11/30/2023 12:00:01 |
- End of batch assignment, with **Use Prior** and **Use First Sample** options enabled:
  | Batch                       | Sample Applied      |
  |-----------------------------|---------------------|
  | 11/30/2023 9:00:00-12:00:00 | 11/30/2023 11:45:00 |

</div>

</div>

### Effective Date/Time

When a sample is applied at the effective date/time, the sample will apply only to the periodic record with an effective date that matches the sample date.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Use Prior">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Use Prior When Current Is Missing or Inhibited</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Use Prior">

When the **Use Prior When Current is Missing or Inhibited** option is enabled, if there is no sample with a sample date matching the batch end date or a periodic record effective date, then the latest sample before the end of batch or periodic record applies.

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Use Prior Ex">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Use Prior Ex">

There are batches that start at 09:00 every four days and end at the start of the next batch (notated on the calendar in blue) and weekly samples as designated by the table to the right.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 566;height: 360;" />

Assignment options are set to apply sample at the end of batch with only the **Use Prior When Current is Missing or Inhibited** option enabled.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 559;height: 119;" />

With this configuration, when there is no sample with the sample date matching the batch end date, batches are applied with the prior sample:

| Batch                    | Sample Applied |
|--------------------------|----------------|
| B1 (4/1 9:00-4/5 9:00)   | A (4/1 9:00)   |
| B2 (4/5 9:00-4/9 9:00)   | B (4/8 9:00)   |
| B3 (4/9 9:00-4/13 9:00)  | B (4/8 9:00)   |
| B4 (4/13 9:00-4/17 9:00) | C (4/15 9:00)  |
| B5 (4/17 9:00-4/21 9:00) | C (4/15 9:00)  |
| B6 (4/21 9:00-4/25 9:00) | D (4/22 9:00)  |
| B7 (4/25 9:00-4/29 9:00) | E (4/29 9:00)  |
| B8 (4/29 9:00-5/1 9:00)  | E (4/29 9:00)  |

</div>

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Apply Back">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Apply Back to Prior Sample</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Apply Back">

When the Apply Back to Prior Sample option is enabled, a sample will apply to the batch or periodic record according to the Apply Sample At option set (End of Batch or Effective Date/Time) and to any previous batch or periodic records, stopping at the sample date of the prior sample. Enabling this option allows for a further condition, Apply Back Within Sample Month, to be applied. This secondary condition limits the application of samples to the month of the sample date.

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Apply Back Ex">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Apply Back Ex">

#### Example 1

There are batches that start at 09:00 every four days and end at the start of the next batch (notated on the calendar in blue) and weekly samples as designated by the table to the right.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 574;height: 365;" />

The assignment is set to apply sample at End of Batch and only the Apply Back to Prior Sample option enabled.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 600;height: 127;" />

Sample A is not applied to any batches during the month of April, as the earliest batch (B1) has a batch end date of 04/05 09:00 which is later than Sample A’s sample date. Instead, Sample B is applied to this batch as it is the next available sample that can be applied back. The last batch B8 does not have any sample applied as no sample has a sample date that matches or is later than the batch end date.

| Batch                    | Sample Applied |
|--------------------------|----------------|
| B1 (4/1 9:00-4/5 9:00)   | B (4/8 9:00)   |
| B2 (4/5 9:00-4/9 9:00)   | C (4/15 09:00) |
| B3 (4/9 9:00-4/13 9:00)  | C (4/15 9:00)  |
| B4 (4/13 9:00-4/17 9:00) | D (4/22 9:00)  |
| B5 (4/17 9:00-4/21 9:00) | D (4/22 9:00)  |
| B6 (4/21 9:00-4/25 9:00) | E (4/29 9:00)  |
| B7 (4/25 9:00-4/29 9:00) | E (4/29 9:00)  |
| B8 (4/29 9:00-5/1 9:00)  | \-             |

#### Example 2

The assignment is set to apply the sample at effective date/time and only the **Apply Back to Prior Sample** option is enabled.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 566;height: 120;" />

With only one periodic record having a corresponding effective date/time to Sample A, the sample is only applied to the periodic record beginning at 04/01 09:00 and ending at 04/01 10:00. The subsequent periodic records have Sample B applied until 04/08 10:00, the first record with an effective date/time that occurs after Sample B’s sample date.

Applying sample at effective date/time is best suited to users with a stronger focus on periodic records rather than batch records.

</div>

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Enabling Both">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Enabling Both Use Prior and Apply Back</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Enabling Both">

When both the **Use Prior When Current is Missing or Inhibited** and **Apply Back to Prior Sample** options are enabled, samples that would be applied under Apply Back to Prior Sample have precedence.

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Enabling Both Ex">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Enabling Both Ex">

#### Example 1

There are batches that start at 09:00 every four days and end at the start of the next batch (notated on the calendar in blue) and weekly samples as designated by the table to the right.

<br/>![](data:image/png;base64,)

The assignment is set to apply sample at the end of batch and both **Use Prior When Current is Missing or Inhibited** and the **Apply Back to Prior Sample** options are enabled.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 584;height: 123;" />

For the batch B1, the Sample B that applies back takes precedence over the sample A that is prior to the batch end date.

| Batch                    | Sample Applied |
|--------------------------|----------------|
| B1 (4/1 9:00-4/5 9:00)   | B (4/8 9:00)   |
| B2 (4/5 9:00-4/9 9:00)   | C (4/15 09:00) |
| B3 (4/9 9:00-4/13 9:00)  | C (4/15 9:00)  |
| B4 (4/13 9:00-4/17 9:00) | D (4/22 9:00)  |
| B5 (4/17 9:00-4/21 9:00) | D (4/22 9:00)  |
| B6 (4/21 9:00-4/25 9:00) | E (4/29 9:00)  |
| B7 (4/25 9:00-4/29 9:00) | E (4/29 9:00)  |
| B8 (4/29 9:00-5/1 9:00)  | E (4/29 9:00)  |

#### Example 2

The assignment is set to apply sample at Effective Date/Time and both Use Prior When Current is Missing or Inhibited and the Apply Back to Prior Sample options are enabled.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 594;height: 126;" />

The periodic record with 04/01 09:00 effective date will be applied with the Sample A since the Sample Date matches. For the next periodic record at 04/01 10:00, there is no sample with a Sample Date matching the effective date. Although Sample A (4/1 09:00) is a prior sample and could be applied, the Apply Back to Prior Sample option has precedence and Sample B (4/8 09:00) is applied back to this periodic record.

</div>

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Use Prior Sample Tolerance">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Use Prior and Apply Back - With Sample Tolerance</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Use Prior Sample Tolerance">

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Enabling Both Sample Tolerance">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Enabling Both Sample Tolerance">

There are batches that start at 09:00 every four days and end at the start of the next batch (notated on the calendar in blue) and weekly samples as designated by the table to the right.

<br/>![](data:image/png;base64,)

Assignment is set to apply sample at the end of batch and both **Use Prior When Current is Missing or Inhibited** and the **Apply Back to Prior Sample** options are enabled. There is a sample tolerance set for 1 day before the end of batch and 1 day after the end of batch.

<br/>![](data:image/png;base64,)

<br/>![](data:image/png;base64,)

The logic for sample application assumes that Apply Back to Prior Sample option has precedence over Use Prior When Current is Missing or Inhibited option. Note that for Batch 5 (4/17 09:00 – 4/22 09:00), there is no sample with a sample date matching the End of Batch date (4/21 09:00). Because of this, sample application would first look for a sample to apply back to this batch. With the Sample Tolerance set to 1 day in either direction, Sample D (4/22 9:00) can be applied.

\*end of batch only

| Batch                    | Sample Applied |
|--------------------------|----------------|

| B2 (4/5 9:00-4/9 9:00)   | B (4/8 9:00)   |
| B3 (4/9 9:00-4/13 9:00)  | C (4/15 9:00)  |
| B4 (4/13 9:00-4/17 9:00) | D (4/22 9:00)  |
| B5 (4/17 9:00-4/21 9:00) | D (4/22 9:00)  |
| B6 (4/21 9:00-4/25 9:00) | E (4/29 9:00)  |
| B7 (4/25 9:00-4/29 9:00) | E (4/29 9:00)  |
| B8 (4/29 9:00-5/1 9:00)  | E (4/29 9:00)  |

</div>
